selection: Every finite contract-valid candidate from the frozen one-query joint/independent-serial generation stage, in generation order; no reference-outcome selection
budget_rationale: Existing 9- and 13-atom reference chains cost 1048 and 1378 GPU seconds; the first current replay cost 1078 seconds and 202 primitives. This separately bounded integration stage admits the predetermined 16-atom reactant and at most two generated candidates, each capped at 3300 seconds and 3000 SCF/gradient/Hessian primitives. Unrefined generated geometries may fail or time out; no success is assumed and no automatic retry or cap extension is allowed. Two 3305-second recovery envelopes fit 2 GPU-hours and 16 CPU-core-hours. This stage uses the finite P2b policy and creates no training allocation.
claim_limits: A functional development pipeline using historical trained weights, with unresolved training overlap; not independent confirmation or a method comparison.
Gas phase is explicitly declared for this new modeling task; the source geometry environment remains unknown.
Unresolved, alternative and matched channels retain distinct evidence states; a pipeline completion does not imply a certified TS.
Generation and reference ledgers are separate and both contribute to end-to-end cost. Scheduler/setup overhead must also be included in later cost comparisons.
Only gas-phase neutral singlet CHNO and this versioned reference protocol are supported; raw coordinates and weights remain private on n2.
